assets.purpose: Mosswater village well; neutral empty bucket and black opening allow truthful polluted/clean HTML state
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE new transparent game prop for DropInn: a small roofless crooked stone well with one plain EMPTY wooden bucket hanging from a short rope over its rim. No roof and no supporting wooden frame. The rope can drape over the near rim into the well; the empty bucket rests against the outside rim. Thick lopsided ring of only five or six broad gray-beige stone shapes, black open hole with no visible water, uneven squat body. Plain brown bucket, no face, no symbols. Neutral reusable object: do NOT show polluted water, clean water, splashes, sparkles, poison or a repaired state. Style matches DropInn's viewed sheep.png, shadow-pack.png and approved hero-style-a.png: coarse, loose MS Paint mouse doodle, blunt irregular black contours with natural raster jaggies, awkward actual shapes, variable imperfect joins, a few broad restrained bucket fills. Very sparse interior lines. Not a polished cartoon or pixel-art grid. Composition: one complete isolated prop, centered in middle 65 percent of a square canvas, at least 15 percent empty transparent margin on all sides; recognizable at 64 pixels. Actual alpha transparency. No background, ground shadow, white rectangle, checkerboard, text, UI, gradients, gloss, hatching, detailed texture, decorative plants or additional subjects.

assets.purpose: Mosswater bog resident and encounter; neutral alert pose preserves one identity
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE new transparent creature cutout for DropInn: a neutral alert little bog creature named Mossback. A lopsided pear-like moss-green body leaning slightly to one side, two deliberately mismatched off-center cream eyes with simple black dots, deadpan small crooked mouth, short clumsy arms and two tiny awkward brown feet. One funny detail only: a bent reed held sideways beneath the nose like a comically uneven mustache. It is a wary character who can be spoken to or fought, not a snarling monster; no attack pose, wound, rage, weapon or magical effect. Flat moss/olive-green body with at most one broad darker green patch, no fur, leaf texture, scales or moss micro-detail. Style matches DropInn's viewed sheep.png, shadow-pack.png and approved hero-style-a.png: coarse loose MS Paint mouse doodle, blunt irregular black contours with natural raster jaggies, awkward actual shapes and variable imperfect joins, broad restrained flat bucket fills. Do not clean it into a polished mascot or deliberate pixel-art grid. Composition: complete isolated full-body silhouette centered within middle 65 percent of a square canvas, at least 15 percent entirely empty transparent margin on all sides. Readable at 64 pixels. Actual alpha transparency; no background, shadow, checkerboard, badge, lettering, UI, gradients, highlights, gloss, hatching, texture or extra subjects.
